name: @etzhayyim/patent-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of the patent registry (global public patent open-data: patents + parties + classifications + citations) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces vertex_patent + edges). Public patent-office data; Tier-3 PII in natural-person. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
